Ref No.: CUJ/EVS/ICECRUNCH/2026/Adv02 Dated: 22.10.2026
ADVERTISEMENT FOR THE POST OF JRF/SRF
Applications are invited for the post of one Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/ Senior Research Fellow (SRF)
under the Indo-Swiss Joint Research Project titled “Ice nucleating particles and cloud condensation nuclei
properties in the North-Western Himalayas (ICE-CRUNCH)”. This project presents a unique opportunity
to study aerosol properties over a high-altitude site in Jammu region in collaboration with ETH Zurich,
Switzerland. The post will be filled up purely on contract basis for one year or completion of the project
whichever is earlier. Candidates will have no right to claim any regular appointment.
The details are as follows:
Project Title Ice nucleating particles and cloud condensation
nuclei properties in the North-Western Himalayas
(ICE-CRUNCH)
Funding Agency Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES)
Position Project JRF / SRF
Consolidated Monthly Fellowship JRF: Rs. 37,000 + 8% HRA
SRF: Rs. 42,000 + 8% HRA
Essential Qualification For JRF: M.Sc. in Environmental Sciences /
Atmospheric Sciences with a minimum of 55%
marks and NET/GATE Examination Qualified.
For SRF: Qualification prescribed for JRF with two
years of research experience.
Desirable Qualification The candidate having in-depth knowledge of
aerosol measurement techniques and data analysis
using MATLAB, Python or similar software /
languages will be given preference.
For SRF: Publication of at least one paper in a peer
reviewed SCI indexed journal in the relevant field
Last Date Extended 13.11.2026
How to apply: Interested candidates who fulfill the above conditions may send their application form along
with a CV, academic transcripts, work certificate (if any) and a 1-page motivation letter stating previous
research experience and interests along with contact details through post or e-mail. The complete
application form(on format attached as Annexure I) along with self-attested testimonials (mentioning post
name and reference number on top of the envelope) shall be mailed or sent on the following e-mail-id/
address:
Dr. Shweta Yadav (Principal Investigator), D-35, Department of Environmental Sciences, Central
University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Distt. Samba- 181143, Jammu (J&K), India, Email:
shweta.evs@cujammu.ac.in, Contact no: 8700244971
General Terms and Conditions:
1. The candidate will be shortlisted for the interview based on merit and will be informed via e-mail. Mere
fulfilling the minimum qualifications will not entitle the candidate for being called for an interview. The
decision of the selection committee will be final in this regard.
2. Candidates shortlisted for interview should appear in person with originals of degree certificates (one
set of self-attested photocopies) and a proof for date of birth (Class 10th Certificate) along with any other
relevant information (e.g. experience certificate, copies of publications if any, awards, recommendations
letters, etc.).
3. The selected individual may be assigned any other duties from time to time commensurate with his/her
qualifications.
4. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.
5. Central University of Jammu reserves every right to cancel out the process and /or not to fill this
temporary position at any stage of selection process.
For further details, please visit university website www.cujammu.ac.in.
Sd/-
Dr. Shweta Yadav
Principal Investigator

Rahya-Suchani, (Bagla), Distt. Samba
